headline: Personnel contract negotiations, bid awards for mechanical service and snow removal, a Chartwells food service contract, and FY 2027-2028 budget planning.
summary: The committee will discuss personnel contracts, including non-renewals and renewals, and vote on a food service contract with Chartwells and bid awards for mechanical service and snow removal. A summer workshop will cover an equity audit, budget planning for FY 2027-2028, and committee self-evaluation.
